source_text: Heu quis vivet cum haec fecerit Deus? Prophetae gemitus de iudicio; gloria Deo in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Alas who will-live when these will-have-done God? Of-prophet groan concerning judgment; glory to-God into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Alas, who shall live when God does this? >> Bible:Numbers 24:23]] — the prophet’s groan over judgment. Glory to God forever. Amen.
